_description: Ransomware groups, leak-site postings, affiliate recruitment, and extortion countdowns. Distinguishes actual underground activity from news coverage by requiring an action term (published/leaked/timer/recruiting) alongside group/actor names, instead of firing on bare mentions.

rules._description: Leak-site posting: a ransomware group has published or is threatening to publish stolen data. Two-signal lookahead: action verb (published/leaked/posted/timer/countdown/deadline) + ransomware context (group name, .onion link, 'leak site', or 'data leak').
rules._fp_risk: Low-medium. News coverage of leak-site activity uses similar language - excludes pin obvious news framing (KrebsOnSecurity, BleepingComputer, etc.).
rules._severity_rationale: Critical - leak-site posting indicates an active extortion event with potential downstream impact.
rules.name: Ransomware - leak site posting

rules._description: Affiliate / pentester recruitment by ransomware groups. Two-signal lookahead: recruitment verb + ransomware operation language (RaaS, affiliate program, percentage split, ransom share).
rules._fp_risk: Low. 'Recruiting pentesters' + 'RaaS affiliate' is not a phrasing legitimate companies use.
rules._severity_rationale: High - recruitment signals operational expansion of a ransomware program.
rules.name: Ransomware - affiliate recruitment

rules._description: Extortion timer / countdown / deadline messaging - common in double-extortion campaigns. Two-signal lookahead: timer/deadline language + ransom/victim context.
rules._fp_risk: Low-medium. Marketing copy uses 'countdown' and 'deadline'. Excludes pin obvious commerce framing.
rules._severity_rationale: High - active countdown signals time-sensitive event affecting a victim.
rules.name: Ransomware - extortion countdown

rules._description: Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) builder / panel / decryptor sales. Two-signal lookahead: RaaS/builder/panel/decryptor + commercial language (subscription, lifetime, monthly, build access).
rules._fp_risk: Low. RaaS builder sales use distinctive jargon not present in legitimate software contexts.
rules._severity_rationale: High - operational artifact distribution signals the spread of ransomware capability.
rules.name: Ransomware - RaaS builder / panel sale
